claims_checked: Notebook uses a U-Net with ResNet18 encoder and MC=5 random patch train/test splits.
Training uses segmentation_models_pytorch TverskyLoss with alpha=0.2 and beta=0.8.
README offers CPU-only as well as GPU environments; a GPU is faster, not a universal prerequisite.
limitations: The notebook training loss is not an independent implementation/verification of the organizer distance-weighted evaluation service.
It does not authenticate our mirrored inputs, organizer receipts, current leaderboard or weekly allowance.
DrivenData, USGS, GDR, Dropbox and NLR PDF hosts are outside the sandbox outbound allowlist. Those sources were not freshly fetched in this review.
